title: $290 for Switzerland's Peaks or $32 for China's Avatar Mountains | China Travel Expert
description:
Switzerland's most famous peak trip runs about $290. China's "Avatar" mountains? About $32 — which do you book?

A round-trip to Jungfraujoch, the "Top of Europe," costs roughly CHF 225–261 (about $250–290) from Interlaken. Zhangjiajie National Forest Park in Hunan — the quartz-sandstone pillars that inspired the floating peaks in Avatar — charges about ¥225–236 (~$32) for entry, and that ticket is valid four days with the eco-shuttle buses included. Both are the core access ticket to a world-famous mountain landscape; cable cars and the Bailong Elevator are extra on the China side. The price gap is real.

🧭 Expert Tip: enter Zhangjiajie from the quieter Wulingyuan gate rather than the main Forest Park gate — same 4-day ticket, far shorter morning shuttle lines.

瑞士最有名的雪山之旅约$290，中国“阿凡达”山群张家界约$32——你选哪个？
